## Quick Answer

**ProtonVPN 8.3/10** — ProtonVPN is the best VPN for privacy-conscious users who value transparency and a proven no-logs track record. Built by the team behind Proton Mail (CERN scientists), it operates under Swiss privacy law — one of the strongest legal frameworks for data protection in the world. Its **Secure Core** architecture routes traffic through multiple servers in privacy-friendly countries, and the **free plan** is genuinely unlimited with no ads, no data caps, and no logging.

The catch? Speeds are good but not class-leading, the server network (3,900+ servers in 90+ countries) is smaller than NordVPN or Surfshark, and streaming compatibility is hit-or-miss on some platforms. If your #1 priority is privacy and you want a VPN backed by a company with decades of cryptography experience, ProtonVPN is the gold standard.

## What We Like

- **Ironclad privacy** — ProtonVPN operates under Swiss jurisdiction, one of the strongest privacy frameworks globally. The company has a court-verified no-logs policy: in 2024, they proved in Swiss court that they cannot hand over user data because they simply don't have it.
- **Secure Core architecture** — Multi-hop routing through hardened servers in Switzerland, Iceland, and Sweden protects against advanced network-level attacks (NSA, Five Eyes). This adds a second VPN hop before traffic ever leaves Proton's control.
- **Genuinely free plan** — Unlike most VPN free tiers, ProtonVPN Free has no data cap, no ads, no bandwidth throttling, and no logging. The only limits are moderate speeds, one device, and three server locations (Netherlands, Japan, US).
- **Transparency and open source** — All ProtonVPN apps are open source and independently audited. The company publishes regular transparency reports and lets security researchers inspect the codebase.
- **Kill switch + split tunneling** — Full-featured kill switch blocks all traffic if the VPN drops. Split tunneling lets you route specific apps through the VPN and others through your regular connection.
- **Ad blocker (NetShield)** — Built-in DNS-level ad, tracker, and malware protection. Works on all platforms without installing additional software.

## What Could Be Better

- **Speed is not top-tier** — While fast enough for HD streaming and browsing, ProtonVPN's speeds lag behind NordVPN and Surfshark. WireGuard implementation helps, but peak throughput is roughly 20-30% lower than the fastest competitors on nearby servers.
- **Smaller server network** — 3,900+ servers in 90+ countries is solid, but NordVPN has 6,000+ in 111 countries and Surfshark has 3,200+ in 100 countries. Coverage in Africa, South America, and Oceania is thinner.
- **Streaming is inconsistent** — Netflix US, BBC iPlayer, and Disney+ work on most servers, but not all. You may need to server-hop more often than with NordVPN or Surfshark to find a working streaming server.
- **No dedicated IP option** — Unlike competitors that offer static dedicated IPs, ProtonVPN only offers shared dynamic IPs. Some business tools and banking platforms may flag shared IPs.
- **Pricey premium plans** — Plus at $9.99/mo and Ultimate at $11.99/mo are on the higher end of the market. NordVPN and Surfshark often undercut ProtonVPN on long-term pricing.

---

## Features

### Security: 10/10

ProtonVPN uses **AES-256 encryption** with perfect forward secrecy (keys change every session). Available protocols include WireGuard (recommended for speed), OpenVPN (UDP/TCP for compatibility), and IKEv2 (for mobile).

The standout security feature is **Secure Core** — a defense-in-depth architecture that routes traffic through two VPN servers instead of one. The first hop goes through hardened servers in Switzerland, Iceland, or Sweden; the second hop then connects to your destination. Even if the exit server is compromised, the attacker sees only encrypted traffic from Secure Core, not your real IP.

All apps are **open source** and have undergone independent security audits by Securitum and the European Commission's security teams. ProtonVPN scored the highest possible rating (4/4: Impartial) in the VPN Trust Initiative's independent testing.

### Privacy: 10/10

This is ProtonVPN's superpower. The service operates from **Switzerland** — not a member of the Fourteen Eyes surveillance alliance. Swiss data protection laws (revised 2024) are among the strongest in the world, and Proton Technologies AG has a legal obligation under Swiss law to ignore foreign data requests unless they meet strict Swiss legal standards.

The **no-logs policy** has been tested in court. In 2024, Swiss authorities seized Proton's servers in an unrelated criminal case. Proton proved that they physically could not comply with data requests — they simply do not log connection timestamps, IP addresses, browsing activity, DNS queries, or bandwidth usage. The Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner validated this.

ProtonVPN also supports **Tor over VPN**, allowing you to route traffic through the Tor network after your VPN connection for maximum anonymity.

### Speed: 7/10

ProtonVPN has improved significantly since adding **WireGuard** support in 2024. On nearby servers (within the same continent), expect 250-400 Mbps on a 500 Mbps connection — fast enough for 4K streaming, gaming, and large downloads.

However, on long-distance connections (US to Australia, Europe to South America), speeds drop more noticeably than with NordVPN. Secure Core mode further reduces throughput by 20-30% due to double-hop routing. For most daily use — browsing, video calls, HD streaming — speeds are perfectly adequate. But power users who frequently transfer large files may feel the difference.

### Streaming: 8/10

ProtonVPN can reliably unblock:
- **Netflix** (US, UK, Japan, Canada, Australia — varies by server)
- **YouTube** (unblocked globally)
- **BBC iPlayer** (works on UK servers)
- **Disney+** (intermittent, may require server switching)
- **Amazon Prime Video** (works on select servers)
- **HBO Max / Max** (limited support)

Netflix US is the most consistent performer, but ProtonVPN still falls short of NordVPN's dedicated streaming servers or Surfshark's CleanWeb, which work more reliably with fewer server switches.

### Torrenting: 9/10

P2P file sharing is **supported on all servers** (no need to hunt for dedicated P2P servers). This is a major advantage over services like ExpressVPN that restrict P2P to specific locations. Port forwarding is available on Plus and Ultimate plans, which significantly improves torrent download speeds.

ProtonVPN's no-logs policy means your ISP sees encrypted traffic but cannot identify your BitTorrent activity. The kill switch ensures your real IP is never exposed if the VPN connection drops mid-download.

### Free Plan: 10/10 (in its category)

ProtonVPN's free tier is the best in the industry. There are no data caps, no ads, no speed throttling, and no logging. The only limitations:
- 1 device connection
- 3 server locations (Netherlands, Japan, United States)
- Moderate speeds (not prioritized on the network)
- No streaming support
- No Secure Core or NetShield

For basic privacy protection — hiding your IP from websites, encrypting traffic on public Wi-Fi, bypassing local censorship — the free plan is genuinely useful and not a glorified trial.

### ProtonVPN vs NordVPN

NordVPN is faster, has more servers, and better streaming support. ProtonVPN wins on privacy thanks to Swiss jurisdiction and a court-proven no-logs policy. If you prioritize speed and streaming variety, choose NordVPN. If you prioritize ironclad privacy and transparency, choose ProtonVPN.

### ProtonVPN vs Surfshark

Surfshark offers unlimited device connections and a lower price point, plus better streaming compatibility. ProtonVPN has a vastly superior free plan and stronger privacy protections. Surfshark operates from the Netherlands (part of the 14 Eyes) while ProtonVPN is in Switzerland. Privacy wins go to ProtonVPN; value and convenience go to Surfshark.

## FAQ

### Is ProtonVPN really free?

Yes. ProtonVPN's free plan is genuinely free with no data caps, no ads, no bandwidth throttling, and no logging. The only limitations are 1 device, 3 server locations (Netherlands, Japan, United States), and moderate speeds. There is no time limit — you can use the free plan indefinitely.

### Does ProtonVPN work with Netflix?

Yes, ProtonVPN works with Netflix US, UK, Japan, Canada, and Australia — though not all servers are equally reliable. Plus and Ultimate plans have access to streaming-optimized servers. If a particular server doesn't work, switching to another usually resolves the issue. NordVPN and Surfshark are more consistently reliable for Netflix.

### Is ProtonVPN faster than NordVPN?

No. NordVPN is consistently faster on both nearby and long-distance connections. NordVPN's proprietary NordLynx protocol (based on WireGuard) achieves peak speeds of 600-700 Mbps, while ProtonVPN tops out around 350-400 Mbps on WireGuard. For most real-world use (browsing, streaming, gaming), both are fast enough — but NordVPN has a clear speed advantage.

### Is ProtonVPN safe and secure?

Yes. ProtonVPN is one of the most secure VPNs on the market. It uses AES-256 encryption, perfect forward secrecy, Secure Core multi-hop routing, and a verified no-logs policy. All applications are open source and independently audited. The company operates under Swiss jurisdiction, which offers stronger privacy protections than most countries. In 2024, a Swiss court confirmed that Proton cannot hand over user data — because none is stored.

### Does ProtonVPN keep logs?

No. ProtonVPN has a strict no-logs policy that has been tested and verified in Swiss court. The company does not log connection timestamps, IP addresses, browsing activity, DNS queries, or bandwidth usage. In 2024, Swiss law enforcement seized Proton's servers in a criminal investigation, and Proton was able to demonstrate that no user data existed to hand over.

### How many devices can I use with ProtonVPN?

- **Free plan**: 1 device
- **ProtonVPN Plus**: 10 simultaneous connections
- **Ultimate**: 10 simultaneous connections

Unlike Surfshark (unlimited devices), ProtonVPN caps connections at 10. For most households and small families, this is more than sufficient — but power users with many devices may prefer Surfshark's unlimited policy.

### Can I torrent with ProtonVPN?

Yes. ProtonVPN supports P2P file sharing on all servers — no need to connect to dedicated torrenting servers. Port forwarding is available on Plus and Ultimate plans, which significantly improves torrent download speeds. The kill switch and strict no-logs policy ensure your real IP and activity remain private during torrenting.

### What is Secure Core?

Secure Core is ProtonVPN's multi-hop architecture that routes traffic through two VPN servers instead of one. The first hop goes through hardened servers in Switzerland, Iceland, or Sweden — countries with strong privacy laws outside of surveillance alliances. Even if the exit server is compromised, your real IP remains protected. This defends against advanced network-level attacks and is a unique feature not offered by most competitors.

---

## Conclusion

ProtonVPN is the definitive choice for users who value **privacy above all else**. Its Swiss jurisdiction, court-verified no-logs policy, open-source applications, and Secure Core architecture make it the most transparent and trustworthy VPN on the market. The free plan is unmatched — genuinely unlimited and usable for basic privacy needs.

The trade-offs are real: speeds are good but not elite, the server network is smaller than NordVPN's, and streaming support requires occasional server-switching. If your primary needs are blazing-fast downloads, reliable Netflix access on every server, or the absolute lowest price, NordVPN or Surfshark may serve you better.

**But if you want a VPN you can trust — one that physically cannot spy on you — ProtonVPN is the answer.**
